source: Mixed: the original rooms/props from Blender scene CoucouOffice (orthographic, az 45, el 30, 280 px/m at 2x); the warm set (room/floor_back.webp, workstation desk/chair SE+SW, props meeting_table/sofa) repainted 2026-10-05 with OpenAI built-in imagegen from this project's layout guides, normalized only, no third-party game art, not CC0; provenance and SHA256 in feature2/辦公室2D素材生成結果/warm/manifest.json
note: Pixel values are in the 2x files; logical = value / 2. World: x along the window wall toward screen-left, y along the right wall toward screen-right, metres; floor 0..6 x 0..6.

worldToScreen.formula: X = x0 + (y - x) * perMetreX; Y = y0 + (x + y) * perMetreY - z * perMetreZ

drawOrder: Per workstation: desk layer, screen content, chair layer, member. Between objects: by x + y of their ground point (larger is nearer the camera).

battle.note: 中二模式 (src/team/office/battle): the boss's states (one canvas, one groundPivot) and the heroes' accessories, rendered in the office camera at 2x; battle/manifest.json has their source and licence. Each theme's battle: where the boss stands, its scale, what makes way, and the heroes' places, front line first (metres). Effects are drawn in code.
